finite_distance_grid.interpretation: These are the prospectively inherited r3b/r3d validation distances. Support at a grid distance demonstrates jointly observable finite-distance geometry there. Failure to find a placement at the maximum deterministic grid resolution is not proof of physical impossibility at that distance or between grid distances.

reuse: continuous time search using deterministic subdivided bounded minimization
published-reference and +/-107 m height sensitivity scoring

joint_observable_requires: ray intersects fixed geocentric-distance sphere forward from generating observatory
apparent direction inside each plate's own side-specific STC polygon
observable_synthetic_design.no_case_interpretation: sampling result only; not proof of physical impossibility
observable_synthetic_design.stop_grid_escalation_when: at least 3 distinct jointly observable placements found in a time-distance case

opportunity_status_precedence: NO_JOINT_OBSERVABLE_CASE_FOUND_AT_MAX_RESOLUTION when zero placements over all frozen cases
FINITE_GEOMETRY_SYNTHETIC_PRECISION_HOLD when any found placement fails recovery or available published-reference stress exceeds 2 arcsec
FINITE_GEOMETRY_SITE_METADATA_STRESS_HOLD when +/-107 m height stress exceeds 2 arcsec
FINITE_GEOMETRY_SYNTHETIC_PASS_DELTAT_UNCERTAINTY_QUALIFIED when all found placements pass but monthly DeltaT without uncertainty is used

population.infinity_sky_geometry: diagnostic only; never an inclusion criterion

deltat.after_decimal_year_1984_5: exact banked v094v monthly deltat.data; no uncertainty column
deltat.monthly_rule: Nominal geometry and C01 uncertainty propagation are allowed. Do not invent a DeltaT uncertainty. Any pair touching monthly DeltaT receives an explicit DELTAT_UNCERTAINTY_UNAVAILABLE qualification and cannot receive an unqualified 2-arcsec physical-precision certification.

r3b_geometry_conventions.bamberg: retain frozen longitude/latitude swap; elevation not swapped

reference_foundation.site_datum_qualification: APPLAUSE horizontal/elevation datum accuracy remains undocumented. The fixed +/-107 m height stress is retained; this does not resolve horizontal datum uncertainty.

scientific_role: Run the already-validated historical topocentric finite-distance geometry and observable synthetic-recovery design over the corrected full v094t OVERLAP population. This is a distance-grid geometry/precision validation, not a real-source matcher and not a proof of continuous-distance impossibility when a grid case yields no placement.
stop_rule: STOP after full-population distance-grid geometry and synthetic-recovery validation. Interpret results before freezing any continuous-distance admissibility search or real-source matcher.
